data.description:
# Prevent `install-pi-extension.sh` from repointing the global symlink from unbuilt worktrees

## Problem statement

Running the npm `install` lifecycle script (via `npm install`) inside an
`implement` worktree executes `scripts/install-pi-extension.sh`, which
unconditionally repoints the **global** Pi extension symlink
(`~/.pi/agent/extensions/worklog`) at that worktree's
`packages/tui/extensions` source directory. When the worktree has not been
built (no `dist/`), the extension's realpath-resolved imports
(`../../../dist/icons.js`, `../../../dist/wl-integration/spawn.js`) fail, so
the Worklog Pi extension — and every Pi command or skill that depends on it —
breaks until the symlink is manually restored.

## Users

- **Developer running `npm install` in a worktree** — currently breaks their global
  Pi extension for the whole machine without warning.
  - User story: *As a developer, when I run `npm install` inside an implement
    worktree, my global Pi extension keeps pointing at the built main checkout so
    my tooling keeps working.*
- **Main-checkout developer** — relies on `npm run install:pi-extension` (or
  `npm install`) to (re)point the global symlink at the built checkout.
  - User story: *As a main-checkout developer, running the installer from a built
    checkout still installs/repoints the extension as before.*
- **Agent working in worktrees** — depends on `wl` CLI integration through the Pi
  extension; a worktree install must not break it mid-session.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] When `REPO_ROOT` contains a `.worklog/worktrees/` path segment, the script makes **no** change to `${TARGET_DIR}` (no create, repoint, rename, backup or delete of `${TARGET_LINK}`), logs a clear skip message, and exits `0` so `npm install` still succeeds.
- [ ] When the extension source is unbuilt — in particular `packages/tui/extensions` has no resolvable `dist` output (sentinel `dist/wl-integration/spawn.js`, and `dist/icons.js` which the entry point also requires) — the script does not create or repoint the global symlink, logs a warning, and exits `0`.
- [ ] When run from a valid, built, non-worktree checkout, existing behaviour is preserved: `${TARGET_LINK}` is (re)pointed at `${REPO_ROOT}/packages/tui/extensions`, and a second run is idempotent (no `.bak.*` churn when the link already targets the source).
- [ ] A regression test is added to `tests/scripts/install-pi-extension.test.ts` that runs the script (or a copy of it) against a fixture path containing `.worklog/worktrees/` and asserts the global extension directory is untouched; the test is hermetic (temporary `HOME`/`PI_GLOBAL_EXTENSIONS_DIR`, stubbed `dist`).
- [ ] At least one test asserts the unbuilt-target guard leaves the global symlink untouched.
- [ ] All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
- [ ] Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- Must remain a `bash` script with `set -euo pipefail`, consistent with
  `scripts/install-herdr.sh`.
- The guard must honour the existing `PI_GLOBAL_EXTENSIONS_DIR` override
  (`TARGET_DIR="${PI_GLOBAL_EXTENSIONS_DIR:-${HOME}/.pi/agent/extensions}"`) —
  tests rely on it for hermetic isolation.
- `npm install` must **not** fail because of the guard in a worktree; the guard
  is a safe no-op, not an error.
- No change to the Pi extension source/runtime logic itself; this is installer
  hardening only.
- Worktrees must never mutate machine-global state.

## Existing state

- `scripts/install-pi-extension.sh` derives `REPO_ROOT` from its own location and
  unconditionally backs up/removes `${TARGET_LINK}`, then `ln -s` to
  `${EXTENSION_SOURCE_DIR}`. Its only guard is that
  `${EXTENSION_SOURCE_DIR}` exists.
- `package.json` runs the installer through the npm `install` lifecycle script:
  `"install": "npm run install:plugin && npm run install:pi-extension"` →
  `"install:pi-extension": "bash ./scripts/install-pi-extension.sh"`. (The task
  title/description previously referred to a `postinstall` hook; the effective
  trigger is the npm `install` script, which fires on `npm install`.)
- `packages/tui/extensions/wl-integration.ts` loads
  `../../../dist/wl-integration/spawn.js` via
  `createRequire(realpathSync(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)))`; the entry point
  similarly requires `../../../dist/icons.js`. Both are compiled output and are
  absent in a fresh, unbuilt worktree.
- `tests/scripts/install-pi-extension.test.ts` currently exercises only the
  success path, using a temporary `HOME`, and asserts the symlink target and
  idempotent re-run. It does not cover worktree or unbuilt contexts.
- Historical fixes that introduced this coupling: commit `0e123688`
  (WL-0MQMFMACS0059UUC) and WL-0MQMFUMW30066FLC both moved extension imports to
  `dist/`; WL-0MQMFUMW30066FLC explicitly recommended *"Add a pre-install check
  to ensure `dist/` exists."* — this item implements that recommendation.

## Desired change

Add two guards to `scripts/install-pi-extension.sh`, evaluated before any
mutation of `${TARGET_DIR}`:

1. **Worktree guard** — if `REPO_ROOT` path contains `.worklog/worktrees/`,
   print a skip message (including the offending path) and exit `0`.
2. **Built-output guard** — validate that the compiled output the extension
   requires exists (at minimum `${REPO_ROOT}/dist/wl-integration/spawn.js`,
   and `${REPO_ROOT}/dist/icons.js` for the entry point). If missing, print a
   warning advising `npm run build`, do not touch `${TARGET_LINK}`, and exit `0`.

Preserve the current create/backup/repoint flow (and idempotency) when both
guards pass.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `scripts/install-pi-extension.sh` — add worktree-context and built-output guards before the `mkdir -p`/backup/`ln -s` block; adjust messaging.
- `tests/scripts/install-pi-extension.test.ts` — add hermetic regression tests for: worktree skip, unbuilt-target skip, and the existing built-checkout success/idempotency path.
- `package.json` — no behavioural change expected; verify the `install` /
  `install:pi-extension` wiring is unchanged and documented.
- `README.md` (or `docs/dev/`) — document the installer's guards and the
  requirement that the installer runs only from a built, non-worktree checkout.
- `packages/tui/extensions/wl-integration.ts` / `packages/tui/extensions/index.ts` — reference only (no change expected); source of the `dist/` dependency.

## Related work

- WL-0MQMFMACS0059UUC — *Extension loads but cannot find icons.js* (completed) — introduced realpath-resolved `dist/` imports.
- WL-0MQMFUMW30066FLC — *Pi extension loads .ts files directly* (completed) — recommended the pre-install `dist/` check implemented here.
- WL-0MSGQ64N2006TQB2 — *Worktree node_modules end-to-end verification* — documents that `dist/` is gitignored and absent in fresh worktrees.
- WL-0MSHZR0J2000Q9SW — *Create npm run install routine for install steps* (completed) — established the `install`/`install:pi-extension` wiring.

## Risks and assumptions

- **Risk:** the built-output guard makes the installer (and its test) depend on
  `npm run build` having produced `dist/`. *Mitigation:* tests build a small
  fixture repo with a stubbed `dist/wl-integration/spawn.js` + `dist/icons.js`
  rather than relying on the real build; the project's build → test ordering
  already guarantees `dist/` for the real success-path test.
- **Risk:** an over-broad worktree check (bare substring `.worklog/worktrees/`)
  could skip installation in an unexpected layout. *Mitigation:* match a path
  segment boundary and log the matched path.
- **Risk (scope creep):** option 3 from the original write-up
  (`--project-scoped` install) is deliberately **out of scope**; if desired it
  should be a separate work item linked via `discovered-from`.
- **Assumption:** worktree contexts are always identified by the
  `.worklog/worktrees/` segment created by `implement.py`.
- **Assumption:** exiting `0` on skip is the correct npm-lifecycle behaviour;
  the installer is a convenience step, not a build gate.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- No clarifying questions were required for this intake — the seed description
  (problem, root cause, options, recommended approach, and ACs) was sufficient
  to produce a complete brief. Evidence: work-item seed description and
  repository inspection of `scripts/install-pi-extension.sh`,
  `tests/scripts/install-pi-extension.test.ts`, `package.json`, and
  `packages/tui/extensions/wl-integration.ts`.
- Correction captured during intake (capture fidelity): the description referred
  to a `postinstall` hook; the actual trigger is the npm `install` lifecycle
  script (`package.json` → `scripts.install`). Source: `package.json`.
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **WL-0MKRRZ2DN0BRRYJC** – Ship Standalone “Folder Binary” Distribution (No npm install) for Worklog CLI (completed)
- **WL-0MSAKPXCD009I1CY** – Pi TUI regroup fix (mirrored) (completed)
- **WL-0MR89UMBD0087CKR** – Mock icons.js import in test (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `packages/herdr/README.md` — matched: absent, acceptance, actual, add, added (+243 more)
- `docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md` — matched: absent, actual, add, agent, already (+221 more)
- `CLI.md` — matched: absent, add, added, adjust, agent (+215 more)

## Goal

Add hermetic regression tests for the two new guards in `scripts/install-pi-extension.sh`:
1. Worktree skip guard — verifies the script exits 0 without mutating the global extension symlink when `REPO_ROOT` contains `.worklog/worktrees/`.
2. Unbuilt-target skip guard — verifies the script exits 0 without mutating the global extension symlink when `dist/wl-integration/spawn.js` or `dist/icons.js` are absent.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **Parent AC 1**: "When `REPO_ROOT` contains a `.worklog/worktrees/` path segment, the script makes **no** change to `${TARGET_DIR}` (no create, repoint, rename, backup or delete of `${TARGET_LINK}`), logs a clear skip message, and exits `0` so `npm install` still succeeds." — Covered by test below.
- [ ] **Parent AC 4**: "A regression test is added to `tests/scripts/install-pi-extension.test.ts` that runs the script (or a copy of it) against a fixture path containing `.worklog/worktrees/` and asserts the global extension directory is untouched; the test is hermetic (temporary `HOME`/`PI_GLOBAL_EXTENSIONS_DIR`, stubbed `dist`)."
- [ ] A test in `tests/scripts/install-pi-extension.test.ts` creates a temporary fixture directory with a `.worklog/worktrees/` path, sets `HOME` to an isolated temp directory, runs the script, and asserts that no symlink file exists at `${HOME}/.pi/agent/extensions/worklog`.
- [ ] **Parent AC 2**: "When the extension source is unbuilt — in particular `packages/tui/extensions` has no resolvable `dist` output (sentinel `dist/wl-integration/spawn.js`, and `dist/icons.js` which the entry point also requires) — the script does not create or repoint the global symlink, logs a warning, and exits `0`." — Covered by test below.
- [ ] **Parent AC 5**: "At least one test asserts the unbuilt-target guard leaves the global symlink untouched."
- [ ] A test in `tests/scripts/install-pi-extension.test.ts` creates a temporary fixture directory with a valid `packages/tui/extensions` source but **no** `dist/` output (no `spawn.js`, no `icons.js`), runs the script with `HOME` pointing to an isolated temp directory, and asserts that no symlink file exists at `${HOME}/.pi/agent/extensions/worklog` and that the script's stderr/stdout contains a warning about missing dist output.
- [ ] Both tests use `PI_GLOBAL_EXTENSIONS_DIR` to ensure hermetic isolation.
- [ ] Both tests exit code is asserted to be 0.
- [ ] All tests pass.

## Key Files

- `tests/scripts/install-pi-extension.test.ts` — add two new test cases.
- `scripts/install-pi-extension.sh` — reference only (guards to be implemented separately).

## Goal

Add two guards to `scripts/install-pi-extension.sh` that prevent it from repointing the global Pi extension symlink when run from a worktree or from an unbuilt checkout.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **Parent AC 1**: "When `REPO_ROOT` contains a `.worklog/worktrees/` path segment, the script makes **no** change to `${TARGET_DIR}` (no create, repoint, rename, backup or delete of `${TARGET_LINK}`), logs a clear skip message, and exits `0` so `npm install` still succeeds."
- [ ] **Worktree guard**: Before any mutation, check if `REPO_ROOT` path contains `.worklog/worktrees/`. If so, print a clear skip message (including the offending path), do NOT create, repoint, rename, backup, or delete the target symlink, and exit 0.
- [ ] **Parent AC 2**: "When the extension source is unbuilt — in particular `packages/tui/extensions` has no resolvable `dist` output (sentinel `dist/wl-integration/spawn.js`, and `dist/icons.js` which the entry point also requires) — the script does not create or repoint the global symlink, logs a warning, and exits `0`."
- [ ] **Built-output guard**: After the worktree guard (if it passes), check that both `${REPO_ROOT}/dist/wl-integration/spawn.js` AND `${REPO_ROOT}/dist/icons.js` exist. If either is missing, print a warning advising to run `npm run build`, do NOT create or repoint the target symlink, and exit 0.
- [ ] **Parent AC 3**: "When run from a valid, built, non-worktree checkout, existing behaviour is preserved: `${TARGET_LINK}` is (re)pointed at `${REPO_ROOT}/packages/tui/extensions`, and a second run is idempotent (no `.bak.*` churn when the link already targets the source)."
- [ ] When both guards pass (built, non-worktree checkout), preserve existing behaviour: create target directory, backup existing link if needed, create new symlink, and print success message.
- [ ] Idempotency preserved: re-running from a built, non-worktree checkout does not churn backup files.
- [ ] The script still uses `set -euo pipefail` and honours `PI_GLOBAL_EXTENSIONS_DIR`.
- [ ] The existing idempotency test (AC3 of parent) continues to pass.
- [ ] All documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
- [ ] Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- Must remain a bash script with `set -euo pipefail`.
- Honour `PI_GLOBAL_EXTENSIONS_DIR` override.
- Exit 0 on skip — npm install must not fail.
- No change to Pi extension source/runtime logic.

## Key Files

- `scripts/install-pi-extension.sh` — add two guard blocks before the `mkdir -p`/backup/`ln -s` block.
